context: Three failed executions of the combined zapret+DoH+Chrome validation harness; all rolled back exactly before promotion.

failures.error: An object at the specified path C:\Users\AA0778~1.EMA does not exist.
failures.rootCause: Elevated Start-Process output redirection used the short %TEMP% path and failed before winws validation.
failures.prevention: Use explicit scratch path under ProjectRoot; never depend on elevated %TEMP% short-path aliases.

failures.error: Cannot bind argument to parameter 'Path' because it is null.
failures.rootCause: Scratch references were replaced but the $Scratch assignment was not actually inserted.
failures.prevention: Static source check must prove assignment-before-use, not only parser success.

failures.rootCause: Chrome headless produced an empty stdout file; Get-Content -Raw returned null and the monolithic harness threw before preserving curl/Chrome trial fields.
failures.prevention: Split validation into independent curl and Chrome gates; persist each stage before cleanup; normalize nullable file reads to empty string.

binaryAudit.correction: Earlier suspicion that blockcheck and standalone used different winws binaries was disproven by hash comparison.

redesign.gate1: Minimal elevated native-DoH + exact winws strategy + Windows curl only; persist stage evidence.
redesign.gate2: Only after gate1 PASS, separate Chrome headless validation using the same proven setup.
redesign.promotion: No integration/service/install until both gates PASS and cleanup is exact.
